design_philosophy.identity: Nigerian Investment App with premium, trustworthy, organic fintech aesthetic. High contrast for readability, avoiding default Vercel-look.
core_principles: Generous spacing to let financial data breathe
Optical alignment over strict mathematical alignment
Dense, bento-grid data presentation on dashboard
No full-screen gradients; focus on texture and solid typography

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold
scales.label: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-bold

typography.instructions: Use font-light or font-black for tension. Avoid regular weight for headings. Never use Inter for headings. Import fonts from Google Fonts.

specific_instructions_for_main_agent.architecture: Build a hybrid fullstack app using React, React Router, Tailwind, Shadcn UI primitives.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.components: Heavily use Shadcn UI (customize to match colors and border radius). Do not build raw HTML selects/dialogs. Use Recharts for any data visualization if needed. Use lucide-react for icons.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='invest-submit', data-testid='admin-approve-withdrawal-btn').
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.nigerian_context: Format currency in Naira (₦). Use standard Nigerian phone number validation where applicable. Ensure Paystack flow is simulated or visually integrated for deposits.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.referral_system: Implement 3-tier tree visual (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3) in the referral view. Provide a clear 'copy link' interaction.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.investment_logic: Show active investments with a visual progress bar or countdown timer (24h) until next payout. Users can invest multiple times in multiple products.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.admin_features: Admin must have a separate layout (dark sidebar, light content area). Must have views to manage users, approve/reject withdrawals, and edit products (image, name, price, daily profit %, duration). Create global settings for generation bonuses and welcome bonuses.
